title: Dandiset is already BIDS
reason: Dandiset is already organized to the BIDS standard. If only a partial conversion is desired, please raise an issue on https://github.com/con/nwb2bids/issues/new to discuss the use case.
solution: Skip the conversion of this Dandiset.
